Features Primal Anthalon is enabled again, but this time its schedule will be fixed. Friday Red Dragon has been replaced by Primal Anthalon Monday and Wednesday Red Dragons have been put on a random roll. These timers will either be RD or P.A. Bug Fixes Enlightened Oracle Necklace now restores the proper amount of mana when damaged. Divine Die now restore the proper amount of mana when damaged. Perfect Lake Lunasigil is now properly craftable. Abyssal charges can now be gained while using Enlightened Necklaces as intended. Scorpion-type tamed mounts now have icons for their skills. A number of Scythes that did not properly reward wisps have been fixed. If you were affected, please submit a support ticket. Hollow Searing Rain now benefits from Magic Range Boost (+5m). Ayanad Earth Leather now has the proper tooltip and stats, 14% Received Damage to Health Enlightened Arcanist Necklace now removes the correct amount of mana when damaged. Enlightened Ayanad Gale Necklaces now give the proper equip effect from their green text. Gale Charm's effect now properly triggers on critical strikes. Ayanad Typhoon Leather now has the correct tooltip, showing the buffed amount of critical damage. The main questline has been reworked to avoid players "bricking" the questline when the Celestial+ Hasla weapon is required. The taming minigame may no longer be bypassed by killing the tameable early. Support-type taming mount armor has Post-Cast Mana Regen as part of it's aura. Ode to Recovery now benefits from both Seaknight and the Enlightened Ayanad Life accessory set effect. Ant's Diligence now properly speeds up players overburdened with a trade pack. Please note: This does not speed up mounts with overburdened players on top of them. Known Issue: Existing ants have the broken (Rider) version assigned, this is being investigated. A number of tooltips have been improved and corrected throughout the game. Thank you to the following discord users for reporting: Nugget Negative Reploid Shinimi
html:
Update10 October 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
📜Patch Notes - October 10, 2026
Cumulative fixes from September 30th to October 10th.

Features

  • Primal Anthalon is enabled again, but this time its schedule will be fixed.
    • Friday Red Dragon has been replaced by Primal Anthalon
    • Monday and Wednesday Red Dragons have been put on a random roll. These timers will either be RD or P.A.

Bug Fixes

  • Enlightened Oracle Necklace now restores the proper amount of mana when damaged.
  • Divine Die now restore the proper amount of mana when damaged.
  • Perfect Lake Lunasigil is now properly craftable.
  • Abyssal charges can now be gained while using Enlightened Necklaces as intended.
  • Scorpion-type tamed mounts now have icons for their skills.
  • A number of Scythes that did not properly reward wisps have been fixed.
    • If you were affected, please submit a support ticket.
  • Hollow Searing Rain now benefits from Magic Range Boost (+5m).
  • Ayanad Earth Leather now has the proper tooltip and stats, 14% Received Damage to Health
  • Enlightened Arcanist Necklace now removes the correct amount of mana when damaged.
  • Enlightened Ayanad Gale Necklaces now give the proper equip effect from their green text.
  • Gale Charm's effect now properly triggers on critical strikes.
  • Ayanad Typhoon Leather now has the correct tooltip, showing the buffed amount of critical damage.
  • The main questline has been reworked to avoid players "bricking" the questline when the Celestial+ Hasla weapon is required.
  • The taming minigame may no longer be bypassed by killing the tameable early.
  • Support-type taming mount armor has Post-Cast Mana Regen as part of it's aura.
  • Ode to Recovery now benefits from both Seaknight and the Enlightened Ayanad Life accessory set effect.
  • Ant's Diligence now properly speeds up players overburdened with a trade pack.
    • Please note: This does not speed up mounts with overburdened players on top of them.
    • Known Issue: Existing ants have the broken (Rider) version assigned, this is being investigated.
  • Taming Mounts with improved swim speeds have had their swim speeds adjusted:
    • Grand = 5.5 m/s
    • Arcane = 6.5 m/s
    • Celestial = 6.7 m/s
  • Hollow Comet’s Boon now reaches to the same height as basic Comet’s Boon
  • Hollow Comet’s Boon now will properly apply the Slowed effect to enemies damaged by the initial hits, and Inspired to allies entering it's cracked ground.
  • Flame Charm's effect has been adjusted to be 100 flat HP -> 1% of the user's max health recovered on block, evasion or parry.
  • Radiant Mettle now requires users to be below 50% -> 90% maximum health.
  • Hollow Ollo's Hammer now properly Disarms and is no longer blockable.
  • The Wrangler's and Herdmaster's backpacks now function again for the purpose of actually taming and not murdering the beasts.
  • A number of tooltips have been improved and corrected throughout the game. Thank you to the following discord users for reporting:
    • Nugget
    • Negative
    • Reploid
    • Shinimi

{{NewsArticle
|title=📜Patch Notes - October 10, 2026
|slug=patch-notes-october-10th-2026
|date=2026-10-10 18:01
|category=Update
|image=News aac discovery thumbnail big-f03e7c.png
|summary=Cumulative fixes from September 30th to October 10th.
|source=https://aa-classic.com/news/patch-notes-october-10th-2026
}}

== Features ==
* Primal Anthalon is enabled again, but this time its schedule will be fixed.
** Friday Red Dragon has been replaced by Primal Anthalon
** Monday and Wednesday Red Dragons have been put on a random roll. These timers will either be RD or P.A.

== Bug Fixes ==
* Enlightened Oracle Necklace now restores the proper amount of mana when damaged.
* Divine Die now restore the proper amount of mana when damaged.
* Perfect Lake Lunasigil is now properly craftable.
* Abyssal charges can now be gained while using Enlightened Necklaces as intended.
* Scorpion-type tamed mounts now have icons for their skills.
* A number of Scythes that did not properly reward wisps have been fixed.
** If you were affected, please submit a support ticket.
* Hollow Searing Rain now benefits from Magic Range Boost (+5m).
* Ayanad Earth Leather now has the proper tooltip and stats, 14% Received Damage to Health
* Enlightened Arcanist Necklace now removes the correct amount of mana when damaged.
* Enlightened Ayanad Gale Necklaces now give the proper equip effect from their green text.
* Gale Charm's effect now properly triggers on critical strikes.
* Ayanad Typhoon Leather now has the correct tooltip, showing the buffed amount of critical damage.
* The main questline has been reworked to avoid players "bricking" the questline when the Celestial+ Hasla weapon is required.
* The taming minigame may no longer be bypassed by killing the tameable early.
* Support-type taming mount armor has Post-Cast Mana Regen as part of it's aura.
* Ode to Recovery now benefits from both Seaknight and the Enlightened Ayanad Life accessory set effect.
* Ant's Diligence now properly speeds up players overburdened with a trade pack.
** Please note: This does not speed up mounts with overburdened players on top of them.
** '''Known Issue:''' Existing ants have the broken (Rider) version assigned, this is being investigated.
* Taming Mounts with improved swim speeds have had their swim speeds adjusted:
** Grand = 5.5 m/s
** Arcane = 6.5 m/s
** Celestial = 6.7 m/s
* Hollow Comet’s Boon now reaches to the same height as basic Comet’s Boon
* Hollow Comet’s Boon now will properly apply the Slowed effect to enemies damaged by the initial hits, and Inspired to allies entering it's cracked ground.
* Flame Charm's effect has been adjusted to be <s>100 flat HP</s> -> 1% of the user's max health recovered on block, evasion or parry.
* Radiant Mettle now requires users to be below <s>50%</s> -> 90% maximum health.
* Hollow Ollo's Hammer now properly Disarms and is no longer blockable.
* The Wrangler's and Herdmaster's backpacks now function again for the purpose of actually taming and not murdering the beasts.
* A number of tooltips have been improved and corrected throughout the game. Thank you to the following discord users for reporting:
** Nugget
** Negative
** Reploid
** Shinimi
